name: Electrostatically screened transformer
summary: A screened transformer includes a documented screen between windings.
description: A screened transformer includes a documented screen between windings. The drawing must show the screen connection separately from the magnetic coupling and winding terminals.
readingNotes: Trace the screen lead to the earth or bonding point specified by the manufacturer.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A screen connection is not an extra power winding or a guarantee of every isolation requirement.
